analog.q_mix: Var_y[Z](x); mixing-availability proxy, not heat release; Z stored as OpenFOAM field T; JSON key q_profile
analog.tau: first of 24 equal-width axial bins with Var_y[Z] < 0.045 (absolute); tau = max(1e-4, x_m / U_b); last-bin fallback; no interpolation
analog.n_index: n = 0.50 + 0.28 tanh(C-1) + 0.16 (1-Um) + 0.10 (o-0.5)^2; g,d,a,s enter only through OpenFOAM C and Um
analog.near_boundary_sigma_mae: E_sigma,boundary = mean |hat_sigma(z)-sigma| on hold-out |sigma|<0.20; not Hausdorff/contour distance
analog.unstable_precision: TP_U / (TP_U + FP_U) on hold-out; 0 if the GP predicts no unstable points
